Medium close-up at eye level, 50mm lens, 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) stands beside the low concrete parapet on an open downtown rooftop, holding the opened lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK) beside her face while her other hand angles a smartphone toward her mouth as a dark reflective mirror, poised just before the touch-up. Her weight is settled toward the skyline-facing path, eyes fixed on the phone reflection, with space around her hands. Potted ornamental grasses stir in the foreground and a distant elevated train crosses behind her among reflective glass towers. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rims the rooftop edges and Scarlett (Image 1), under a pale sky. Clean, bright, tactile editorial product photography with true color, airy shadows, vivid coral accent, and subtle handheld energy.
